gse244832.allowed_use: External-development frozen RNA-query cell-state robustness and donor-by-cell-state secondary rank/correlation diagnostics only. Different RNA and ATAC aliquots are never identity-paired.
gse244832.model_access: No GSE244832 rows, distances, correspondence estimates, PCA/scaling state, labels, ATAC, early stopping, heads, projection, or calibration may enter a model scored on GSE244832.

gse289173.allowed_use: One-time RNA-only cell-state mapping through frozen raw-count preprocessing, transform_one, and the locked common head. No ATAC or profile confirmation is possible.
gse289173.model_access: Anonymized raw RNA only; no labels, eQTL/ieQTL outcomes, second modality, correspondence fitting, PCA/scaling updates, head fitting, projection, or calibration before prediction hashes are committed.

gse296875.allowed_use: Outer-training same-nucleus RNA-ATAC modeling with an explicit validated identity P, followed by donor-held RNA-only cell mapping and secondary cross-modal diagnostics.
gse296875.model_access: Only outer-training donors define features, assay preprocessing, PCA, scaling, P, learned correspondence, model state, early stopping, heads, projection, or calibration. Held donor ATAC is evaluator-only.

local_model_roster.common_lane: frozen RNA transform_one posterior mean plus identical common head
local_model_roster.native_lane: JAMIE integration and unbounded modal_predict output reported separately; no primary ATAC profile score

pairing_rules.gse244832: same_sample_different_aliquot; never identity-paired and never used to learn correspondence when it is the evaluation source
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA_only sealed query; no second modality or correspondence operation
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus; explicit identity P only after exact donor/sample/nucleus and ordered row-ID validation

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, paired rows, imputed peaks, and latent coordinates are not replicates.
rules.feature_and_transform_contract: Genes, peaks, raw-assay recipe, PCA dimensions/components, preclass moments, correspondence P, and output order are frozen inside outer-training donors.
rules.profile_rule: Unbounded inverse-PCA ATAC predictions cannot enter the primary multinomial/profile-deviance endpoint. Secondary rank/correlation metrics must be registered before evaluation.
rules.query_isolation: Use model.eval plus transform_one or modal_predict with RNA only. Never estimate distances or correspondence, fit transforms, or pass a second query modality.
